paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.

annotations.annotation: The chart illustrates the negative log probability for various per-specialty terms, with bars grouped by the specialty categories of "Cardio", "Gastro", "Infect", "Neuro", "Obstetrics", and "Pediatrics", representing different aspects of the MistralV0.2-Base model fine-tuned on these specialties. The horizontal axis contains labeled categories listed in the order mentioned, with each grouped set exhibiting different colored bars corresponding to the specialties: light blue for MistralV0.2-Base, light orange for "Cardio", orange for "Gastro", darker orange for "Infect", light brown for "Neuro", medium brown for "Obstetrics", and dark brown for "Pediatrics". The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” with a linear scale, ranging from -27 to -22, and marked at intervals of one unit. Each bar group consists of several bars varying in height across specialties, with all being uniform in color for their respective specialty within each grouping. Cardio bars overall are taller compared to others. and Infect bars are shorter overall. All the groups, light blue bar is always the tallest. No specific sorting or visual emphasis, such as shading or bolding, is indicated for the individual bars or groups. The blue bars representing MistralV0.2-Base tend to be the tallest, while the remaining bars' heights vary slightly, with some consistent trends within each category. All bars are starting from -22, downwards towards -27. A legend is given top center.
